text:
maya: heads-up — seeing a sharp rise in 4xx from EU on /v1/generate starting ~2026-03-17T10:12Z. ~15% 4xx, mostly 429 and 408. clients report timeouts. anyone know where per-route rate-limiter and ingress timeout metrics live? thinking to quiet alert briefly.

infra-bot: ALERT: route_error_rate_high /v1/generate (eu) triggered at 2026-03-17T10:13Z — 14.8% 4xx in last 5m. incident: https://console.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-20260317-45 :rotating_light:

ryan: check dashboards -> https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/observability/route-errors?route=/v1/generate&region=eu
also check Prometheus metric: http_server_requests_total{route="/v1/generate",status=~"4.."}.

jun: quick PromQL to isolate 429s:
sum(rate(http_server_requests_total{route="/v1/generate",status="429"}[1m])) by (instance)

and ingress timeout metric:
sum(rate(nginx_upstream_timeout_total{route="/v1/generate"}[5m]))

jun: logs query (Loki):
{app="ingress", route="/v1/generate"} |= "504" or |= "timeout" | json | status

sara: I can mute the route-error alert for 30m. @maya do you want that? Also runbook: https://console.redwood.ai/runbooks/route_4xx.md

maya: yes please mute for 30m. grabbing a couple of request-ids and a cURL to repro.

maya: curl example with X-Request-ID:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Request-ID: test-req-123" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -d '{ "prompt": "hi" }' -v
```

ryan: also check circuit-breaker rejects:
sum(rate(downstream_rejects_total{route="/v1/generate"}[1m])) by (zone)

jun: if it's client-side spikiness, quick mitigations: add rate-limit fallback in routing policy (canary to slower model) or return 429 with Retry-After. we can suggest product back off.

maya: got a sample request-id: test-req-1234-abc. logs show "upstream timeout" on EU-nginx-02. will paste trace shortly.

sara: muted alert and added note on incident page. :white_check_mark:

maya: thanks all — will update in 15m if still noisy.
